# Phase 7.5 comparison tables (generated by scripts/summarize_phase7_5.py from results/phase7_5/*.json)

A simulated reviewer accepts every actionable proposal, so 'false tasks' and 'false edges' are what an accept-everything reviewer would get. Fixtures are developer-written short chat messages and mirror the author's own phrasing; treat the numbers as a functional comparison, not accuracy.
